method: Read-only source, records, review comments, and arithmetic over existing coverage JSON; no target imports or target/test execution. Manual skill-guided review, not an execution of the four mission-assurance MCP tools.
authority_boundary: Owner directed HOLD bars feature/lifecycle progression and promotion; only reproduction, diagnosis, derivative repair, regression and evidence reconciliation are permitted. Independent reviewer cannot release HOLD or admit operation.
integration_boundary: Owner has withheld remaining integration instructions; reconciliation closure cannot imply authorization or qualification for that stage.
